messages:
tara: postmortem follow-up: transient routing churn + dns TTL flap caused LB client retry amplification and intermittent tls handshakes across regions. short action tracker below. keep replies to ack + ETA.

ACTION (owners / ETA):
1) route-controller: add linearized update queue to avoid overlapping route writes (owner: ben) - ETA: 2026-04-07
2) dns client: respect registrar 429 semantics + exponential backoff w/ jitter (owner: yuki) - ETA: 2026-03-31
3) lb: cap concurrent cross-region handshakes per-peer and add quick-fail threshold (owner: ben) - ETA: 2026-04-02
4) probe: nightly synthetic that flips dns ttl and measures retry amplification, alert if amplification_ratio > 1.5 (owner: tara) - ETA: 2026-03-29
5) runbook + comms: mitigation steps + customer note for passthrough configs (owner: product@redwood) - ETA: 2026-04-04

ben: ack. i'll implement a single-writer queue for route updates and add an integration test that simulates concurrent updates. plan to gate with feature flag route/single-writer.

yuki: ack. i'll add registrar backoff map and default to conservative delays for known registrars. will add unit tests and a small e2e.

tara: for the probe i'll create a small cURL harness and a datadog monitor. probe example:
```
POST /internal/probe/dns-ttl-flip
{ "from": "us-east-1", "to": "eu-west-1", "concurrency": 30, "rounds": 200 }
```
Alert on amplification_ratio > 1.5 or error_rate increase > 2%.

ben: question - do we want the handshake cap at 8 or 12? 8 reduces blast radius more but might affect throughput for some heavy customers.

yuki: prefer 8 as default with per-customer override. we can document in the advisory.

ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket NET-FW-6019 assigned to tara, ben, yuki, product@redwood. First sync scheduled 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: tag=route-queue.v1 region=us-west-2 queued_ts=2876543250. dashboard: /dashboards/net-reconcile-canary.

tara: mitigation note: for next 48h enable soft-prefer-local feature flag when amplification > 1% to limit cross-region retries. will coordinate SRE to monitor.

ben: pushed draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/3902 - route queue + tests. requesting review from @yuki.

yuki: will review today and add registrar backoff PR reference. also adding a changelog note for passthrough users.
	ara: thanks all. update this thread with PR links/status or blockers. if ETAs slip, call it out so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
